caseStudies.name: Radha
caseStudies.challenge: Faced domestic violence, triple talaq attempt, and eviction. Later diagnosed with a brain tumor while fighting for her rights.
caseStudies.action: Mahila Panchayat conducted counseling sessions with her husband, provided medical guidance, and facilitated mediation hearings.
caseStudies.outcome: Her husband agreed to reunite with Radha, take financial responsibility, and support her medical treatment.

caseStudies.name: Sunita
caseStudies.challenge: Continuous domestic violence from her husband leaving visible injury marks; severe emotional and psychological distress.
caseStudies.action: Persistent counseling, home visits, and mediation even when husband initially refused to attend hearings.
caseStudies.outcome: Sunita and her husband are now living together with significant positive improvement in their relationship.

caseStudies.name: Kiran
caseStudies.challenge: Husband addicted to alcohol — abused her, sold household items, and often forced her and children out of the house.
caseStudies.action: Repeated counseling and home visits; husband was eventually admitted to a de-addiction center for 6-7 months.
caseStudies.outcome: Husband returned sober, apologized, and now contributes to household expenses in a peaceful family environment.

caseStudies.name: Meera
caseStudies.challenge: Four years of physical violence, neglect, lack of financial support, and husband pressuring for divorce while having another relationship.
caseStudies.action: Sustained counseling over a long period; both parties invited for formal hearings and facilitated dialogue.
caseStudies.outcome: Meera returned to her matrimonial home; husband and mother-in-law showed significant positive behavioral change.

caseStudies.name: Asha
caseStudies.challenge: Daughter-in-law Asha causing family disputes, neglecting meals, discouraging husband from work, and affecting children's education.
caseStudies.action: Phone counseling followed by formal hearing where both her mother-in-law and Asha could share their perspectives.
caseStudies.outcome: Asha returned to her in-laws' home; no further disputes and the family is now living peacefully.

caseStudies.name: Geeta
caseStudies.challenge: Husband quarreled with her, used physical violence, gave no financial support, and abused her parental family.
caseStudies.action: Both parties summoned for a hearing; constructive dialogue facilitated and husband counseled on respect and responsibilities.
caseStudies.outcome: Her husband committed to no violence, respectful treatment, and regular financial support. Geeta confirmed positive change.

caseStudies.name: Lata
caseStudies.challenge: Father-in-law and brother-in-law physically assaulted her at night, causing serious injuries and leaving her frightened.
caseStudies.action: Team ensured medical examination at a government hospital, supported police complaint, accompanied Lata and followed up with authorities.
caseStudies.outcome: Father-in-law and brother-in-law arrested. Atmosphere at home improved. Lata now lives with dignity and confidence.

caseStudies.name: Rani
caseStudies.challenge: Husband quarreled frequently and gave no financial support for her and their six-month-old daughter; living at father's house for a year.
caseStudies.action: Her husband called for counseling; he admitted his mistakes and committed to responsibility for his wife and child.
caseStudies.outcome: Family reunited. Her husband took Rani and their daughter back home and committed to their care.

caseStudies.name: Neha
caseStudies.challenge: Her husband took irresponsible loans, didn't work regularly, and engaged in frequent arguments and physical violence.
caseStudies.action: Her husband invited for counseling; both shared concerns, and he acknowledged his mistakes openly during the session.
caseStudies.outcome: Her husband now works as a battery rickshaw driver and committed to supporting wife and son. Couple reunited.

caseStudies.name: Pallavi
caseStudies.challenge: Husband pressured her to quit her night-shift job, leading to constant conflict and mental stress at home.
caseStudies.action: Women's Panchayat counseled husband on women's right to financial independence and importance of mutual trust.
caseStudies.outcome: Husband agreed to respect her job; Pallavi now successfully manages work and family. Relationship significantly improved.

caseStudies.name: Sarita
caseStudies.location: GD Colony, Mayur Vihar Phase-3, Delhi
caseStudies.challenge: Her husband drank daily, argued with her, gave no household money; Sarita's eyesight weakened from stress but she worked on.
caseStudies.action: Her husband called to Women's Panchayat and counseled on his harmful behavior and family responsibilities.
caseStudies.outcome: Her husband quit alcohol, now contributes to expenses and shares responsibilities. Family living peacefully; children attending school.

caseStudies.name: Rekha
caseStudies.challenge: Husband neglected family responsibilities, gave no financial support, and engaged in verbal abuse and conflicts.
caseStudies.action: Women's Panchayat provided guidance, built her confidence, and connected her children to the CAC learning program.
caseStudies.outcome: Rekha Rekha became financially self-reliant. She now independently manages her children's education, health, and future.

caseStudies.name: Deepa
caseStudies.challenge: Husband's alcohol addiction caused nightly disturbances, violence, disrupted children's studies, and severe financial hardship.
caseStudies.action: Mahila Panchayat arranged admission to a de-addiction center, negotiating fee from ₹6,000 down to ₹3,000.
caseStudies.outcome: Husband admitted for de-addiction treatment. Deepa felt empowered to continue working and caring for her children.

caseStudies.name: Vidya
caseStudies.challenge: Constant domestic violence and harassment from her husband.
caseStudies.action: Mahila Panchayat provided rights awareness and guidance on building confidence and self-sufficiency.
caseStudies.outcome: Vidya now works independently, cares for her daughter, and no longer stays silent against wrong treatment.

caseStudies.name: Kavita
caseStudies.challenge: Husband assaulted her, forced her out of home, consumed alcohol, came home late; in-laws insulted and pressured for money.
caseStudies.action: Both families counseled; husband advised on legal consequences of dowry demands and abusive behavior.
caseStudies.outcome: Her husband rented a separate home in Shahdara and bought Kavita a phone; Kavita started working. No further disputes.

caseStudies.name: Manju
caseStudies.challenge: Harassment from in-laws who consumed alcohol at home, husband staying out late and neglecting her when ill, financial dependence causing humiliation.
caseStudies.action: Her husband counseled to arrange separate accommodation and take responsibility for Manju's well-being.
caseStudies.outcome: Her husband rented a separate room within two months and arranged household essentials. Both reconciled and Manju is now secure.

caseStudies.name: Seema
caseStudies.challenge: Her husband drank alcohol, engaged in physical violence, and failed to contribute adequate financial support.
caseStudies.action: Repeated follow-ups until her husband appeared; multiple counseling sessions with both sides over several meetings.
caseStudies.outcome: Her husband committed to improving behavior, staying away from alcohol, and fulfilling family responsibilities.

caseStudies.name: Reena
caseStudies.challenge: Two years of physical violence, verbal abuse, economic exploitation; jewelry taken away; husband and in-laws refused to attend hearings.
caseStudies.action: Repeated phone contact and warning of legal action; firm follow-up led husband and in-laws to take the matter seriously.
caseStudies.outcome: Husband came forward and took Reena back, assuring respectful treatment and improved behavior.

caseStudies.name: Shanti
caseStudies.challenge: Even while living separately, she faced harassment over property and jewelry matters; in-laws threatened to kill her.
caseStudies.action: Written complaint filed at the local police station; police questioned the opposing party and warned of legal consequences.
caseStudies.outcome: Threats and harassment stopped after police intervention; both parties reached a mutual understanding through mediation.

caseStudies.name: Uma
caseStudies.challenge: 16 years of marriage with physical abuse, verbal insults, and husband not working or contributing to the household.
caseStudies.action: Husband summoned to Panchayat eventually; both parties presented views and detailed counseling was held.
caseStudies.outcome: Husband stopped quarreling and violence, started working and contributing to household expenses. Uma now lives happily.

caseStudies.name: Nisha
caseStudies.challenge: 18 years of marriage; husband gave no financial support, used abusive language, and mother-in-law instigated him leading to violence.
caseStudies.action: Husband and mother-in-law summoned; both parties attended hearing eventually and counseled on responsibilities.
caseStudies.outcome: Husband treats Nisha respectfully, no disputes or violence, contributes to expenses. Mother-in-law stopped instigating.

caseStudies.name: Farida
caseStudies.challenge: Sister-in-law frequently argued with her brother, disrespected elderly mother, and left the marital home after a serious dispute.
caseStudies.action: Opposite party contacted multiple times; both parties attended hearing eventually after repeated notifications.
caseStudies.outcome: Sister-in-law's behavior improved significantly; now cares for Farida's mother and family lives without conflicts.

caseStudies.name: Ruksana
caseStudies.challenge: Husband addicted to alcohol, stayed home and argued constantly, did not work; entire family supported by elderly mother-in-law.
caseStudies.action: Husband summoned multiple times; warned of court referral. On 30 Jan 2026 he appeared and acknowledged his mistakes.
caseStudies.outcome: Husband went outside Delhi for work, sends money regularly, and stopped alcohol. Family lives happily and peacefully.

caseStudies.name: Ayesha
caseStudies.location: Ghadoli Gaon, Shiv Mandir Chowk, Delhi
caseStudies.challenge: Husband verbally abused her, insulted her parents, physically assaulted her, and gave no money for personal expenses.
caseStudies.action: Husband warned of court referral; appeared eventually. Both parties given opportunity to present views and counseled.
caseStudies.outcome: Husband stopped fighting and abuse, now gives Rs.1,000 monthly for personal expenses. Ayesha lives happily and peacefully.

caseStudies.name: Sabina
caseStudies.challenge: Brother-in-law regularly visited her home, verbally abused and fought with her for 6 months; mother-in-law blamed her instead.
caseStudies.action: Brother-in-law warned of court action; appeared on 19 Feb 2026. Counseled and asked to acknowledge his behavior.
caseStudies.outcome: Brother-in-law stopped visiting or harassing her. Sabina now lives peacefully with her husband and children.

caseStudies.name: Naseem
caseStudies.challenge: Physically disabled (leg impairment), her husband drank alcohol and subjected her to arguments, abuse, and violence.
caseStudies.action: Her husband called for hearing; he admitted his behavior and acknowledged that alcohol leads to conflicts at home.
caseStudies.outcome: Her husband promised to stop alcohol, refrain from violence, and treat his disabled wife and children with respect.

caseStudies.name: Rukhsar
caseStudies.challenge: Her husband came home drunk, refused to contribute to expenses, and abused both Rukhsar and their 17-year-old daughter.
caseStudies.action: Multiple hearings; husband's uncle and respected relatives invited for discussions, creating community pressure for change.
caseStudies.outcome: Her husband stopped alcohol and violence, takes responsibility for expenses, treats wife and daughter with dignity and respect.

caseStudies.name: Waheeda
caseStudies.challenge: Husband came home drunk, argued, used abusive language, sometimes assaulted her, and did not work or contribute financially.
caseStudies.action: Husband called for hearing; both parties heard carefully. Counseled on consequences of his behavior and family responsibilities.
caseStudies.outcome: Husband committed to regular work, stopping alcohol, contributing to household expenses, and treating Waheeda with respect.

caseStudies.name: Suman
caseStudies.challenge: Her husband frequently quarreled causing mental distress; family migrated from Bihar with no relatives nearby for support.
caseStudies.action: Hearing held eventually; her husband counseled on consequences of abusive behavior. He acknowledged mistakes and apologized.
caseStudies.outcome: Couple living peacefully with mutual understanding. Her husband stopped fighting; children are happy and family is harmonious.

caseStudies.name: Kamla
caseStudies.location: Gharoli Village, Shiv Mandir Chowk, Delhi
caseStudies.challenge: Her husband got angry over small issues leading to quarrels and physical violence; three daughters affected by family stress.
caseStudies.action: Her husband called for hearing; counseled to control his anger, take care of children, and maintain a calm home atmosphere.
caseStudies.outcome: Her husband assured he would control anger, take care of his health and family, and refrain from quarreling in the future.

caseStudies.name: Vandana
caseStudies.challenge: Husband consumed alcohol and used abusive language even in front of children; repeated requests from family went unheard.
caseStudies.action: Husband invited to Women's Panchayat; counseled on negative impact of alcohol and verbal abuse on wife and children.
caseStudies.outcome: Husband reduced alcohol, returns home quietly, and no longer creates disturbances. Family environment significantly improved.

caseStudies.name: Poornima
caseStudies.challenge: Husband quarreled, used abusive language, gave no financial support, ate separately, and ignored her deteriorating eyesight.
caseStudies.action: Husband finally appeared eventually; both parties heard and counseled; mutual settlement reached with agreed conditions.
caseStudies.outcome: Husband stopped quarrels and abuse, contributes to expenses, and took Poornima to hospital for eye treatment. Family peaceful.

caseStudies.name: Alka
caseStudies.challenge: Husband drank alcohol, physically abused her, quarreled frequently, restricted her movement, and gave no financial support.
caseStudies.action: Both parties called for hearing eventually; carefully heard and counseled. Mutual settlement reached with conditions.
caseStudies.outcome: Husband stopped quarrels and abuse, now provides money for her personal expenses. Married life and family peace improved.

caseStudies.name: Renu
caseStudies.challenge: Lived in a domestic violence environment, had very limited freedom to move outside, and was forced to discontinue her education.
caseStudies.action: Joined Women's Panchayat; attended adolescent group meetings, legal literacy sessions, and enrolled in a tailoring center.
caseStudies.outcome: Now confident, preparing to resume studies via Open School, and inspires other girls. Her mother also joined Women's Panchayat.

caseStudies.name: Sushma
caseStudies.challenge: Her daughter (18) married by choice; Sushma feared her daughter was under pressure from husband's family and could not contact her.
caseStudies.action: Counseling meeting eventually with Sushma, her daughter, and in-laws. Her daughter confirmed she married willingly and is happy.
caseStudies.outcome: Misunderstandings resolved; in-laws welcomed Sushma to visit freely. Mother-daughter bond restored, both families reconciled.

caseStudies.name: Anju
caseStudies.challenge: In-laws and visitors drank alcohol at home causing conflicts; her husband neglected her; both parents deceased with no support.
caseStudies.action: Her husband counseled to arrange separate accommodation and take responsibility. Given 2 months to secure stable employment.
caseStudies.outcome: Her husband rented a separate room, arranged household essentials, and committed to Anju's care. Both reconciled and live peacefully.

caseStudies.name: Meenal
caseStudies.challenge: Widowed for 12 years; her elder son addicted to substances, created disturbances at home and at daughter's in-laws' house.
caseStudies.action: Her son appeared eventually after repeated follow-ups; both parties heard and counseled; mutual settlement reached.
caseStudies.outcome: Her son stopped visiting sister's house to create conflicts; Meenal and family now live more safely and contentedly.

caseStudies.name: Payal
caseStudies.challenge: Her husband accumulated large debt and was not engaged in regular work, creating severe financial burden on the family.
caseStudies.action: Her husband called for counseling; both agreed Payal would continue vending to repay debt while her husband would work for family needs.
caseStudies.outcome: All debt cleared. Family living a secure and peaceful life. Payal is happy and shares a positive relationship with her husband.

caseStudies.name: Ritu
caseStudies.challenge: Her husband gave most earnings to his brothers, leaving Ritu and four children with barely enough food to survive.
caseStudies.action: Mahila Panchayat counseled her husband and his brothers on children's welfare and consequences of neglecting his own family.
caseStudies.outcome: Her husband stopped giving earnings to brothers, now fully supports family. Children back in school; family stable and happy.

caseStudies.name: Sonia
caseStudies.challenge: Her husband drank alcohol and assaulted family; one night forced son and daughter out of the house late at night.
caseStudies.action: Her husband counseled on legal consequences of abandoning children, child protection services, and harm done to family.
caseStudies.outcome: Her husband stopped alcohol, focuses on work, and treats family with care and respect. Children feel safe; family lives happily.

caseStudies.name: Nargis
caseStudies.challenge: Her husband frequently shouted, argued, and left home in anger; once disappeared for a long period leaving family alone.
caseStudies.action: Her husband called multiple times; counseled on responsibilities as husband and father, and importance of stability for three children.
caseStudies.outcome: Her husband returned home; couple lives peacefully. Children receive care and attention; family is happier and more harmonious.

caseStudies.name: Yasmin
caseStudies.challenge: Her husband spent earnings on alcohol and substances, verbally and physically abused her, neglected children and family.
caseStudies.action: Police complaint filed at the local police station; her husband detained and questioned. Family encouraged to pursue de-addiction treatment.
caseStudies.outcome: Her husband works regularly, reduced substance use, takes responsibility for family. Written settlement eventually. Family united.

caseStudies.name: Firdaus
caseStudies.challenge: Her husband drank alcohol, beat children and Firdaus, and forced her out of the house late at night.
caseStudies.action: Her husband called for repeated counseling; made aware of harm to children's emotional well-being, education, and future.
caseStudies.outcome: Her husband developed loving relationship with children, treats wife with care and respect. Family lives in peace and security.

caseStudies.name: Bina
caseStudies.challenge: Three sons and daughters-in-law gave no financial support; husband unemployed; health issues prevented Bina from working.
caseStudies.action: Sons and daughters-in-law called for counseling; made aware of duty to support parents and share household responsibilities.
caseStudies.outcome: Sons began contributing monthly financial support. Bina feels respected and supported; lives with greater dignity and peace.
